samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_subtractor">
	<!--Q = Number of fractional bits-->
	<!--N = Total number of bits including integer and fractional bits-->
	
	<!--Inputs-->
	<input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First N-bit fixed point input operand.</input>
	<input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second N-bit fixed point input operand.</input>
	
	<!--Outputs-->
	<output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">Result of the fixed point subtraction.</output>
	
	<!--Internal Registers-->
	<reg id="res" width_description="[N-1:0]">Register to hold the result of the fixed point subtraction.</reg>
	
	
	<!--Logic Description-->
	<logic_description type="combinational_logic">
		
		//Same sign subtraction
		assign c[N-1]=a[N-1]^b[N-1];
		assign c[N-2:0]=(a[N-2:0]>b[N-2:0])?((a[N-2:0]-b[N-2:0])):(~(a[N-2:0]-b[N-2:0])+1);
		
		
		//Different sign subtraction
		assign c[N-1] = ((a[N-1]==0 && b[N-1]==1) || (a[N-1]==1 && b[N-1]==0)) ? (a[N-1]?0:a[N-1]):c[N-1]; //Set sign bit based on magnitude comparison
		
		//Handle Zero
		assign c[N-1] = ~|c[N-2:0] ? 1'b0 : c[N-1]; //If all bits except the sign are 0, set the sign bit to 0
	end
</module>
